approach: The root-cause fix (documented split, `Records::all_invocations`, `RoleNeed::compute` reading only that, system facts, spec text, known-active replay tests) already landed in base commits 41539a7 and b670592 (HISTORY.txt l.6-22). This job adds the class guards, so the gap cannot reopen, and a separate CHANGELOG bullet. (1) A pure function `unchained_invocation_lists(struct_src, fn_src) -> Vec<String>` in the store.rs test module finds every `Records` field whose type is a `Vec` of `Invocation`, written short or with any path prefix, and reports the ones not named in the `all_invocations` body. A synthetic-struct unit test (fourth list with a full path, not chained) shows it reporting that list. A second test applies it to the real `Records` source and requires `>= 3` fields found. (2) A complete role list, `Role::ALL` in athena-data, kept complete by a test with an exhaustive `match` on `Role`. The store `from_parts` coverage test and a new role_need classification test both use it. (3) `MEASURED_ROLES` const in role_need.rs replaces the local list in `compute`. An exhaustive-`match` test requires every `Role::ALL` entry to be exactly one of measured or on demand. A new Role variant then fails to compile in two tests, and must be classified, and gets loaded in the `from_parts` test. (4) A separate CHANGELOG bullet names the root cause and both guards. Producer first Greps criteria 1, 2, 5 and 6 against the working copy and edits docs, spec.toml, status.rs, display.rs, lib.rs and the CLI test only if a Grep shows a mismatch. No refusal rule is added, so no corpus case and no refused-share number apply.

decisions.choice: Give the author the fact at the point of use (doc comments on `JobRecords::invocations` and `Records`, system-facts entry, one accessor `all_invocations`), and add guards that fail when a list or a role is left out. Already in the base; this job adds the guards only.
decisions.reason: The failure came from missing information at the point of use. The guards keep the information true when a fourth list or a ninth role appears.

rejected.option: A generic gate refusing any new measure not replayed on real records
rejected.why: Out of scope. Information is preferred; giving the author the split prevents the failure.
Wide change: it is read by many callers (run/close.rs, drain, steward, tests) and tells the author no more than the doc plus a tested accessor.

decisions.choice: The fourth-list scan is a pure function `unchained_invocation_lists(struct_src, fn_src)` in the store.rs test module. A field counts as an invocation list when its type is `Vec<...>` whose generic argument's last path segment is `Invocation` (so `Vec<Invocation>` and `Vec<athena_data::records::Invocation>` both match, `Vec<PriorInvocation>` does not). The real-source test asserts found `>= 3`, not `== 3`.
decisions.reason: Answers finding 1: `Records` writes many types with full paths (store.rs:241-270), so a short-form-only pattern misses a fourth list. `>= 3` only guards against a silently empty scan; a new list is judged by whether it is chained. A synthetic test makes the guard's failure part of the diff (finding 2).

rejected.why: Misses full-path spellings and fails a correctly chained fourth list for the wrong reason.

rejected.option: Destructure every `Records` field in a macro
rejected.why: Forces edits to about 25 unrelated fields and every construction site.

decisions.choice: Add `Role::ALL: [Role; 8]` in crates/athena-data/src/records.rs, with a completeness test using an exhaustive `match` (no wildcard) that maps each variant to its index. Use it in the store `from_parts` coverage test (replacing the hand-written eight-role array at store.rs:718-727) and in the role_need classification test.
decisions.reason: Answers finding 3: one complete list covers routing and classification, so neither test can drift. Same `ALL` const pattern as `InterventionCategory::ALL` (records.rs:162) and `CycleStage::ALL`. records.rs is under crates/ and is not governance, but it is not in the brief's deliverable list; this is a small extension and is flagged in risks.

rejected.option: Keep separate hand-written role lists in each test
rejected.why: They drift independently; the store list (store.rs:718) is already one such copy.

decisions.choice: Hoist the built-in measured roles (role_need.rs:127-133) to `pub const MEASURED_ROLES: &[Role] = &[Reader, Planner, Critic, Producer, Verifier]`, same order. Test: for each of `Role::ALL`, an exhaustive `match` says Measured or OnDemand; `MEASURED_ROLES` and `ON_DEMAND_ROLES` must agree and not overlap.
decisions.reason: A new Role variant otherwise gets no count and no retire flag, silently. The exhaustive match forces a decision at compile time.

rejected.why: A new role would be silently unmeasured.

decisions.choice: Leave status.rs `improvement_cycle` and introspection.rs untouched, and cite the existing both-outcomes tests as the evidence that its stage is not always true: `introspection_cycle_replay_over_mixed_proposals_finds_both_outcomes` (crates/athena-data/src/records/introspection.rs:934) and `status_prints_the_improvement_cycle_line_for_both_outcomes` (crates/athena-cli/tests/status_build_measurement.rs:76).
decisions.reason: Answers finding 4: the reading's condition ('unless the both-outcomes test shows the stage is always true') is evaluated and found not met, so the files stay out of scope. Not skipped.

rejected.option: Rename or rework the evaluated stage
rejected.why: Both-outcomes tests exist and pass in the base, so the stage is not always true.

steps: Grep criteria 1, 2, 5 and 6 against the working copy: store.rs:29-32, docs/system-facts.md:44-48, docs/spec.toml:1495-1501, role_need.rs:535 test, CHANGELOG.md:12-25, xtask/shard-timings.txt:41,51,55. In store.rs test module add `fn unchained_invocation_lists(struct_src: &str, fn_src: &str) -> Vec<String>`: take lines of `struct_src` matching `pub <ident>: Vec<T>,` where the last `::` segment of T equals `Invocation` (skip `///` lines), return the idents not found in `fn_src`. In role_need.rs add `pub const MEASURED_ROLES: &[Role] = &[Role::Reader, Role::Planner, Role::Critic, Role::Producer, Role::Verifier];` with a doc comment, and use it in `compute` in place of the local `all_roles` array (l.127-133), same order.

In the role_need.rs test module add `every_role_is_measured_or_on_demand`: for each role in `Role::ALL`, an exhaustive `match` (no wildcard) returns Measured for Reader, Planner, Critic, Producer, Verifier and OnDemand for Steward, Audience, Auditor; assert `MEASURED_ROLES.contains(&r)` and `ON_DEMAND_ROLES.contains(&r)` agree with the class and that no role is in both.

In CHANGELOG.md add a separate bullet under Unreleased/Added: root cause is invocations kept in four places with nothing guarding the list of sources or the list of roles; the fix landed in 41539a7 and b670592; this change adds the `Records` field scan (full-path aware), `Role::ALL`, `MEASURED_ROLES` and the exhaustive-match classification test.

Run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`; fix any failure. Run `cargo test -p athena-data records`, `cargo test -p athena-core store` and `cargo test -p athena-core role_need` first.

risks.risk: The source scan is brittle to formatting changes in store.rs.
risks.mitigation: The function works on text between `pub struct Records {` and the first line that is exactly `}`, skips `///` and blank lines, and takes the field as `pub <ident>: <type>,`. The real-source test requires `>= 3` fields found, so a scan that goes silently empty fails loudly. The synthetic test pins the matching rules (short path, full path, decoy `Vec<PriorInvocation>`, multi-line doc comments).

risks.risk: Adding `Role::ALL` touches athena-data, which is not in the brief's deliverable list.
risks.mitigation: It is one const plus one test in an existing crate under crates/; no behavior changes. It is the single complete role list that finding 3 asks for.

risks.risk: The base already holds the root-cause fix, so the diff's tests do not show the old blind-measure failure.
risks.mitigation: The CHANGELOG bullet and the criterion 7 demonstration say so. The diff's tests show the guards failing: the synthetic fourth-list test and the compile-time `Role` matches. The old assertions are checked in the base by Grep.

risks.risk: No replay over real `records/` is possible: the snapshot has none.
risks.mitigation: The fixtures copy the real shape (out-of-job roles are separate Invocation records routed by `from_parts`), and the status_role_need.rs test goes through the real `athena status` path. The measure only advises and the plan changes no counts, so no real-record expected range applies.

risks.risk: Producer duplicates work already in the base or edits files that need no change.
risks.mitigation: Step 1 is to Grep each criterion against the working copy; the six no-change deliverables are edited only if a Grep shows a gap.

demonstrations.method: Run the role_need unit tests. In base: `known_active_roles_are_never_retire_candidates_and_an_unused_role_is` (l.335) loads steward, audience and auditor runs only into `Records::steward_runs/audience_runs/auditor_runs` and asserts they are not candidates and are listed in `not_measured`, while planner, critic and the unused custom role are candidates. `the_measure_yields_both_outcomes_on_a_mixed_fixture` (l.410) gives an empty and a non-empty candidate list. demonstrations.observes: All pass. The new test shows every `Role` is classified exactly once; the existing tests show the auditor, steward and audience are reported as not measured and never as retire candidates, and that the measure gives both outcomes.
demonstrations.fails_without: If `compute` read `job.invocations` instead of `all_invocations`, the steward, audience and auditor counts would be 0, so the `not_measured == [(steward,1),(audience,1),(auditor,1)]` assertion fails; `this_module_reads_usage_only_through_all_invocations` (l.577) also fails. These assertions are in the base, not in this diff. A role left out of both `MEASURED_ROLES` and `ON_DEMAND_ROLES` fails the new classification test (this one is in the diff).
demonstrations.seam: Production entry point `RoleNeed::compute(&Records)` (role_need.rs:82). Guards: window of 8 jobs that ran a model, `counts_as_work` (l.68). Fixture: in-module `known_active()` (l.301-332) builds a `Records` and pushes out-of-job runs by direct field assignment, using real `Invocation` values from `status::planning_cost_tests::invocation`. demonstrations.observes: All pass. The synthetic struct holds the three real lists plus `pub hestia_runs: Vec<athena_data::records::Invocation>` with an `all_invocations` body that chains only the first three; the function returns exactly `["hestia_runs"]`. The same source with the fourth list chained returns an empty list. A decoy field `Vec<PriorInvocation>` is not reported. The real-source test finds `>= 3` lists and none unchained.

Without `all_invocations` chaining a list that `from_parts` routes, the from_parts test fails on the missing (seq, role) pair. A new `Role` variant fails to compile in the `Role::ALL` completeness test until it is added to `ALL`, and then is loaded by the from_parts test.
